mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_specialist (id, username, specialist_name, remark, password_hash, enabled, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{specialistName}, #{remark}, #{passwordHash}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE data_specialist SET username = #{username}, specialist_name = #{specialistName}, remark = #{remark}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, specialist_name AS specialistName, remark, password_hash AS passwordHash, enabled, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, create_user AS createUser, update_user AS updateUser FROM data_specialist WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, username, specialist_name AS specialistName, remark, password_hash AS passwordHash, enabled, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, create_user AS createUser, update_user AS updateUser FROM data_specialist WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id AS tenantId, t.code AS code, t.name AS name FROM tenant t INNER JOIN data_specialist_tenant dst ON dst.tenant_id = t.id WHERE dst.specialist_id = #{specialistId} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
